summary_1line: At the princes’ martial exhibition, Bhima and Duryodhana nearly fight before Drona halts them and presents Arjuna, whose dazzling skill electrifies the crowd.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima and Duryodhana circle each other in the arena with raised maces, roaring like enraged elephants as the crowd divides and shouts their names.
Drona in white robes halts the combat and presents Arjuna, who steps into the arena in golden mail shining like a sunset-lit storm cloud.
Kunti watches from the platform as cheers for Arjuna erupt, tears mingling with milk upon her breast while conchs and drums thunder around the arena.
